description: E-commerce shopping training tasks using eBay app

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the eBay mobile app from the home screen.

rubric.check: eBay app is visible in post-screenshot with search bar or product listings.
No crash dialog or error visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use search function in eBay to search for a product.

rubric.check: Search was performed and results page is shown.
Search results are related to bluetooth headphones or headphones.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must scroll down the eBay search results to see more products.
tasks.prompt: 在eBay搜索结果页向下滚动查看更多商品。

rubric.check: Page content changed showing different products.
Still showing eBay search results.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must tap on a product listing to view its detail page.
tasks.prompt: 在eBay点击一个商品查看详情。

rubric.check: Product detail page is shown with product info, price, and action buttons.
No longer on search results list view.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must scroll down on eBay product detail page.
tasks.prompt: 在eBay商品详情页向下滚动查看更多信息。

rubric.check: Page scrolled showing more product information or description.
Still on product detail page.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must add product to watchlist or favorites in eBay.
tasks.prompt: 在eBay将当前商品添加到关注列表。

rubric.check: Agent clicked on watchlist, favorite, or heart icon.
Action completed with confirmation or list updated.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must navigate back from product detail to search results.
tasks.prompt: 从eBay商品详情页返回搜索结果。

rubric.check: Used back button or gesture.
Post-screenshot shows search results list.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must browse categories or menu in eBay.

rubric.check: Categories menu or navigation drawer is visible.
Product categories are displayed.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must navigate back to eBay home page.

rubric.check: eBay home page with featured items or search bar visible.
Not on search results or product detail.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must close eBay app and return to home screen.

rubric.check: Device home screen is shown.
eBay app is no longer in foreground.
